description: This Java class defines an Akka actor 'BlockedNamespacesUpdater' responsible for updating and maintaining a distributed cache of blocked namespaces. It handles subscription to namespace-blocking commands and processes these commands to update the cache, sending appropriate responses. It also manages error handling during these updates.

classes.name: BlockedNamespacesUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor class that manages a cache of blocked namespaces, subscribes to relevant namespace command messages, processes block/unblock commands, and handles error reporting.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for actor instantiation with specific blockedNamespaces cache and pubSubMediator.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic for the actor, including processing block/unblock commands, subscription acknowledgments, and logging unhandled messages.

methods.name: blockNamespace
methods.description: Handles BlockNamespace command by adding the namespace to the cache and responding with a success message. Exceptions are forwarded to error handler.

methods.name: unblockNamespace
methods.description: Handles UnblockNamespace command by removing the namespace from the cache and responding accordingly.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Exception handler that logs the error and replies to the sender with a detailed runtime exception message.
